title: Coherent quotient towers for integral scalar extension
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, finite coefficient extensions $E\subset L\subset F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure, with valuation rings and uniformizers $\varpi_E,\varpi_L,\varpi_F$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For $W=X,Y$ put $A_{W,m}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m)_W$, $B_{W,m}=(\mathcal O_L/\varpi_L^m)_W$, $C_{W,m}=(\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^m)_W$, and $R_{E,W}=\varprojlim_mA_{W,m}$ on the small pro-etale site. Use the coefficient maps and quotient transitions of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Let $M,N\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and let $P\to M,Q\to N$ be flat-term K-flat representatives over $R_{E,Y}$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and write $P_m=P\otimes_{R_{E,Y}}A_{Y,m}$ and likewise for $Q$.

Let $s_{W,m}(K)=K\otimes_{A_{W,m}}B_{W,m}$ on flat-term K-flat complexes; its derived interpretation and K-flatness are those of [lem-pur-kflat-change-of-rings]. Let $c_E,c_L$ be the finite cochain tensor-pullback comparisons [lem-pur-cochain-pullback-tensor-coherence]. Write
$$\kappa_K:s_{X,m}f_{E,m}^*K\cong f_{L,m}^*s_{Y,m}K,\qquad
\sigma_W:s_{W,m}\operatorname{Tot}(K\otimes K')\cong\operatorname{Tot}(s_{W,m}K\otimes s_{W,m}K')$$
for the canonical scalar-association and tensor scalar-extension chain maps; here $f_{E,m}^*,f_{L,m}^*$ are termwise module pullbacks for the indicated constant coefficient rings [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and all total tensors have their signed differentials [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. The quotient complexes $s_{Y,m}P_m$ and $s_{Y,m}Q_m$ identify, by $(x\otimes a)\otimes b\mapsto x\otimes ab$, with $P\otimes_{R_{E,Y}}B_{Y,m}$ and $Q\otimes_{R_{E,Y}}B_{Y,m}$. They form normalized coherent $B_\bullet$-systems [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower, lem-pur-coefficient-extension-reduction-model].

The maps $\kappa,\sigma$ and $c$ on these models are strict maps of the quotient towers. Their scalar-extension square satisfies the chain-map identity
$$c_{L;sP_m,sQ_m}\,f_{L,m}^*(\sigma_Y)\,\kappa_{\operatorname{Tot}(P_m\otimes Q_m)}
=(\kappa_{P_m}\otimes\kappa_{Q_m})\,\sigma_X\,s_{X,m}(c_{E;P_m,Q_m}).$$
Both routes carry a local homogeneous tensor $b\otimes(x\otimes y)$, after the inverse-image and scalar-association identifications, to $(b\otimes x)\otimes(1\otimes y)$. This identity and its inverse commute with all quotient transitions. For $L=E$ the scalar comparisons are identities; for $E\subset L\subset F$ their successive comparisons agree with the direct $E\subset F$ comparisons, as strict-system equations under the scalar-association maps. The derived limits of $\kappa,\sigma$ are the canonical pullback and tensor scalar-extension isomorphisms of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension], under the coherent reduction identifications of [lem-pur-coefficient-extension-reduction-model]. This pins their actual quotient representatives and all transition maps, including for ramified extensions; no flatness of $A_{W,m}\to B_{W,m}$ is assumed.
